body:
The user follow-up did not identify another path or backup location for the original July renderer tapes, manifests or comparator. Original-image identity therefore remains unresolved. The three exact newly reconstructed pairs remain classified as NEW_RECONSTRUCTION; this answer does not waive or satisfy the original identity obligation.

A further bounded filename/metadata search found no candidates under `C:\Users\alarisadmin\Desktop`, `Documents`, `Downloads`, `Pictures` and `OneDrive`: all five roots were accessible, with nine directory enumerations and 18 entries, and no access or search-limit gaps. This was a name search for Sirius/DNGR/July/tape/manifest/comparator/2026-07 terms, not a content audit or a search of all storage. Three Documents links were not followed; Pictures was searched directly. No AppData, system directories, other users, other clones, network locations or cloud hydration were included. The retained preparation records also explicitly say that the historical tapes, manifest and comparator were not recovered. Original provenance remains open.
